evidence_quotes.O: The Powershot G9 has been with me through India, East Africa, Dubai, and New York City. It has logged about 25,000 air miles
evidence_quotes.C: It's easier and, in the long run, cheaper, to master a single external meter that works with all the cameras.
evidence_quotes.E: More than once, I've been asked "How do you blur the background like that?"
evidence_quotes.A: Apple has a history of being slow to admit mistakes (how many years did we suffer through those hockey-puck mice?).
evidence_quotes.N: Do these people even test their own software?
